description.value: A small neighbourhood café and scratch bakery on the Vancouver seawall at Leg In Boot Square, a few minutes west of the Cambie Street Bridge. Convivial bakes everything fresh on-site throughout the day — from triple chocolate cookies and cheese-jalapeño scones to handmade artisan loaves — and serves rotating daily soups, toasted sandwiches, and espresso-based drinks. The café has a strong community focus, outdoor seating, and is a natural pit stop for cyclists riding the seawall.

address.value: 680A Leg In Boot Square, Vancouver, BC V5Z 4B4

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: wall_loops (8 spaces) at 26m; stands (4 spaces) at 29m; rack (5 spaces) at 34m; rack at 80m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides comprehensive details. Address (680A Leg In Boot Square), phone (604-675-9885), and email are confirmed from the contact page, supplementing OSM which has no address or phone. The business is confirmed open in May 2026 — a seasonal January winter hiatus is noted on the website but the current date is well outside that window. No bike-specific amenities (racks, Wi-Fi, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website; takeout and numerous vegetarian menu options are explicitly confirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open café and bakery on the Vancouver seawall with a confirmed address, phone, and active website — a natural and useful stop for cycling tourists on the seawall route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian options: vegetarian chili, miso roasted broccoli soup, a range of savory vegetarian scones (cheese jalapeño, four cheese, tomato basil parmesan, etc.), and a vegetarian sandwich (Sincronizada).
